usage.who: packages/gateway/test/session-state/session-state-old-desktop-matrix.test.ts (cross-version matrix cell B: OLD desktop x NEW gateway). The test replays every entry below against the REAL gateway /chamber/session-state* surface and checks status, key sets and the old parse path. Any future compat tooling that must speak as the v0.4.0-beta.1 client reads the same file.
usage.whenToUpdate: Only when the INTERFACE major version changes (control-plane PROTOCOL_VERSION, i.e. the descriptor `protocol` field). A major bump adds a NEW file anchored at that major (for example route-table-2.0.0.fixture.json). This v0.4.0-beta.1 file then stays frozen forever: the old desktop it records can no longer be rebuilt from this repository, so rewriting it would destroy the only forward-compatibility evidence.
usage.howToUpdate: Append-only. NEVER rename, delete or rewrite an existing route / method / path / status / frozen key entry - those entries ARE the old-client record. Post-freeze RETIREMENTS are the one sanctioned exception: never delete a frozen entry - append a tombstone entry (id / method / path + retired: true + the fail-closed expected status) and record the removal under postFreezeRetirements. The matrix replays every tombstone and asserts the fail-closed answer, so an accepted break stays visible and reviewed instead of vanishing. A 0.4.x minor that adds a capability appends only: a new id to `features.addedAfterFreeze`, a new path to `routesAddedAfterFreeze`, a new field to a route's `expect.additiveKeys`, or a new post-freeze nested key list under `expect.nested` (each with an entry in `anchor.postFreezeAdditions`). Features.clientRequired / features.addedAtFreeze and every EXISTING frozenKeys or nested key list are immutable; appended lists only record what this client never read anyway.
usage.whyFrozen: Plan section 6 and protocol-compat-blueprint section 2.2/3.1: the old desktop cannot be produced in-repo, so the only executable evidence that a NEW gateway stays backward compatible is replaying this recorded call sequence. A test that re-derives its expectations from the current server can only prove the server equals itself.
usage.scope: /chamber/session-state* only (snapshot / stream; the read / read-all POST routes were retired post-freeze, see postFreezeRetirements). Other old-desktop routes are outside this fixture.
